gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.q1: What can I do with this service?
gettingStarted.a1: This service is a tool that allows you to create your own original portfolio with intuitive operations. You can attractively summarize your skills, works, and career, and use it for job hunting and self-introduction.
gettingStarted.a2: First, please create an account from the registration page. After registration, you can start creating your portfolio immediately.

account.title: About Your Account
account.q1: How do I register a new account?
account.a1: Please register by setting a username, email address, and password from the 'Register' button in the upper right corner of the screen.
account.a2: Your email address or password may be incorrect. Please check for case sensitivity and try again. If you still cannot log in, please try resetting your password.
account.a3: Please reset your password from the password reset page by entering your registered email address.
account.q4: I want to change my account information (name, icon, etc.).
account.a4: After logging in, please select 'Settings' from the account menu in the upper right corner of the screen. You can change your username, bio, icon image, etc. on the profile settings screen.
account.q5: I want to delete my account.
account.a5: You can delete your account from the account settings tab on the 'Settings' page. Note: Once you delete your account, all data, including the created portfolio, will be permanently deleted and cannot be restored.

portfolio.title: Creating & Editing Portfolios
portfolio.q1: How do I create a portfolio?
portfolio.a1: After logging in, if you have not created a portfolio, you will be automatically redirected to the creation page. On the creation page, decide on a title for your portfolio, select your favorite design from the three templates, and press the 'Create' button.
portfolio.q2: Can I change the portfolio title or template later?
portfolio.a2: Currently, we do not offer a feature to change the title or template of a portfolio once it has been created. If you wish to change it, please delete the portfolio and create it again.
portfolio.a3: By turning on the 'Edit Mode' switch in the upper right corner of the portfolio page, you can add, edit, delete, and change the layout of projects (cards). If you just want to view the portfolio, please turn this switch off.
portfolio.q4: How do I add a project (card)?
portfolio.a4: With 'Edit Mode' turned on, press the 'Add Project' or 'Add Text' button displayed at the top of the page. A modal for entering the necessary information will be displayed.
portfolio.q5: I want to change the appearance (color, image) of a project (card).
portfolio.a5: With 'Edit Mode' turned on, click the edit icon (pencil mark) displayed in the upper right corner of each card. A style editing modal will open, allowing you to change the background color, text color, background image, etc.
portfolio.q6: I want to change the size and position of a project (card).
portfolio.a6: When 'Edit Mode' is on, you can drag and drop each card to your desired position. You can also freely change the size by dragging the bottom right corner of the card.
portfolio.q7: How do I delete a project (card)?
portfolio.a7: With 'Edit Mode' turned on, click the delete icon (trash can mark) displayed in the upper right corner of each card. After a confirmation message is displayed, it will be permanently deleted.

projectPage.title: About Project Pages
projectPage.q1: What can I do on a project page?
projectPage.a1: Clicking on each project card in the portfolio will take you to the detail page for that project. Here, you can freely arrange text, headings, images, and videos to explain the specific content and development history of the project in detail.
projectPage.q2: How do I add content (text, headings, images)?
projectPage.a2: On the project page, you can also enable editing by turning on 'Edit Mode' in the upper right corner. Pressing the 'Add Content' button will display a modal for setting the type and content you want to add.
projectPage.q3: I want to change the appearance (font size, color, background) of the content.
projectPage.a3: In 'Edit Mode', you can edit the style by clicking the edit icon (pencil mark) displayed in the upper right corner of each content block.
projectPage.q4: I want to change the layout (position and size) of the content.
projectPage.a4: When 'Edit Mode' is on, you can move each content block by drag-and-drop, or change its size by dragging the bottom right corner.

hobbies.title: About Hobbies
hobbies.q1: What happens when I register my hobbies?
hobbies.a1: When you register your hobbies from the 'Settings' page, they will be displayed as a 'Hobbies' section on your portfolio page. This helps to convey your personality and character.
hobbies.a2: After logging in, you can add new hobbies or delete existing ones from the 'Manage Hobbies' tab on the 'Settings' page.
hobbies.q3: Can I register my game play records and favorite music?
hobbies.a3: Yes. 'Manage Hobbies' has dedicated tabs for 'Game Play Records' and 'Music Appreciation'. From there, you can create a library of games you have played, or register your favorite music genres and artists.

other.title: Others
other.q1: What is the recommended environment for use?
other.a1: This service is recommended for use with the latest version of Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge on a PC. Some features may not work correctly on other browsers or on smartphones/tablests.
other.q2: I have a problem that is not resolved. / I want to send feedback or requests.
other.a2: We apologize for the inconvenience. Please contact our support desk at {{email}} with a detailed description of the situation. We also welcome your opinions and requests for service improvement.
